transformation.terms: Upstream source licenses; repackaging adds no restrictions.

limitations: Publisher-stated source terms, not an assertion of ownership of every underlying right. No raw dataset redistribution.

training.loss: candidate cross entropy against human distribution when available, otherwise gold label
training.checkpoint_selection: lowest uncalibrated development NLL; test and calibration not read during training
training.initialization: fresh zero-output LoRA; immutable base; no previous adapter or optimizer

selection.gate: NLL improves unchanged base and accuracy loses at most 2 percentage points

data.initialization: Fresh LoRA on unchanged base; no prior adapter or calibration.
data.license_scope: Only CC BY, MIT and CC0 sources allowed for all fitting; preserve source attribution.
data.pretraining_contamination: Unknown; these exclusions apply to this adaptation only.

gpu.name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition

metric_notes.failures: Included as incorrect in accuracy; excluded from probability metrics with explicit n.
metric_notes.ece: 10 equal-width bins of maximum class probability, not API confidence.
metric_notes.nll: Natural log; probabilities floored at 1e-12 for this metric only.
metric_notes.brier: Multiclass sum of squared errors; binary Brier also reported for Noul.
metric_notes.noul_threshold: Yes when P(yes) >= 0.5, including an exact tie.
metric_notes.ordinal: Zero-based expected score MAE and normalized ranked probability score.
metric_notes.human: TVD to normalized human vote shares, where provided.

protocol.selection: Fresh LoRA selected by uncalibrated canonical development NLL; fixed readout.

base.objective: hard-label NLL on validation records only
base.limitations: Global calibration only; validation fit is not held-out test performance. No weight changes.

adapter.limitations: Global calibration only; validation fit is not held-out test performance. No weight changes.
